_comment: One entry per spoken line. Put a clip filename (in assets/audio/) into `file` to play it for that line; leave "" for the synthesized blip. `key` is sceneId:beatIndex and must match the story — regenerate with `npm run voices`.

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.text: One of you will be promoted to Senior Project Lead by Friday. May the best of you win.

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.text: Thrilled to help steer the team through this transition!

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: …did he just imply he's already leading the project?

lines.speaker: Todd
lines.text: So — the promotion thing. If I just… did more, they'd notice, right? I could take the demo prep. And the notes. And the testing.

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.text: Between us — Gary's good, but he can't lead. People skills, you know? You and me should make sure the right person gets this.

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.text: One deck for Wednesday's demo. Coordinate. Share credit. No drama.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Can you review my section before the demo? I want it to be good.

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.text: Mm. Love where my thinking is going here.

lines.speaker: Todd
lines.text: I think I can get it all done by tonight.

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.text: I just want to understand what happened.

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.text: So. Who touched it last?

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: I checked the history. The break came from the deck branch. The one that got… reorganized on Tuesday.

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Okay so everyone's saying the project's a disaster and someone did it on purpose. Wild, right?

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.text: Just checking in. Grab a seat.

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.text: I've noticed some patterns this week. Moved meetings. A deck that got harder to read. A build that broke at a very convenient time.

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.text: Help me understand.

lines.speaker: Todd
lines.text: I think it was me. The build. I'm going to tell Linda everything. Including the stuff I saw other people do.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: Whatever happened this week… I think it's going to come down to you and me tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Gary
lines.text: We could keep clawing at each other. Or we could just… not.

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.text: Before I announce anything… is there anything anyone wants to say?

lines.speaker: Emily
lines.text: Funny week, huh? Especially since I moved that first meeting. And nudged a couple of rumors. Just to see what you'd all do.

lines.text: Okay. Here's what's going to happen.
